declarations.name: isFromInteractiveContent
declarations.description:
Whether `event` started on an interactive element placed inside `row` (a delete button in the `suffix-icon` slot, a
checkbox, a text field…) rather than on the row itself. The row and the parent list leave such events alone: the
click is neither turned into a row click nor a selection, and Enter / Space reach the control.

A selectable row. On its own it is a toggle: click, Enter or Space flips `selected`. Inside a `c2-list` (and
therefore inside a `c2-select`) the list drives the selected state through context, handles the keyboard and the row
only reports clicks. The default slot is the primary text, `description` a second, muted line, `prefix-icon` and
`suffix-icon` take an inline SVG, a `c2-feather-*` icon or a `c2-mat-icon` and are sized by
`--c2-list-item__icon--size` — anything else in them, a shortcut hint or a badge, keeps its own size.
Interactive content placed in a row (a delete button in `suffix-icon`, a checkbox in `prefix-icon`) keeps its own
events: clicking it neither selects the row nor fires the row's `click`, the original event bubbles on with the
control as its `target`, and Enter / Space activate the control instead of the row.
With `href` the row is a link; `current` marks the link of the page the reader is on (`aria-current="page"`), as a
navigation list does for the current route, and draws it with the `current` variables. In a multiple-selection list, adjacent selected rows lose the corner radius between
them (the list sets `joinedBefore` / `joinedAfter`, exposed as `:state(joined-before)` / `:state(joined-after)`) so a run of
selected rows reads as one block.

Accessibility: standalone rows are `role="button"` with `aria-pressed`; rows in a list are `role="option"` with
`aria-selected` and a roving `tabindex` managed by the list. Set your own `role` to override.

members.name: contextConsumer
members.default: new ContextConsumer(this, { context: selectedItemValueContext, subscribe: true, callback: (value) => { this.selected = value ? value.includes(this.value) : false }, })

members.name: selected
members.description: Whether the row is selected. Toggled by a click on a standalone row; controlled by the list otherwise.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Dims the row and ignores clicks and keyboard.

members.name: value
members.description: The value reported to the parent list / select.

members.name: label
members.description:
Text shown by the parent select for this row instead of the slotted content. Also the fallback content of the
default slot when it is empty. Use it when the row content is rich (icons, two lines) but the trigger should show a
short label.

members.name: href
members.description: Makes the row a link. Selection still works when the row sits in a list.

members.name: current
members.description:
Marks the row as the current page of a navigation list: announced as `aria-current="page"` and drawn with the
`--c2-list-item__current--*` variables, which default to the selected look. Independent of `selected`.

members.name: target
members.description: Browsing context used when `href` is set, such as `_blank`.

members.name: data
members.description: Arbitrary payload returned alongside `value` in the list's `selection-change` event. Not an attribute.

members.name: joinedBefore
members.description:
Private: set by the parent `c2-list` (or written as an attribute by `c2-virtual-list`) when the row above is
selected too, so the facing corners square off. Exposed as `:state(joined-before)`; never reflected.

members.name: joinedAfter
members.description: Private: the `joinedBefore` counterpart for the row below. Exposed as `:state(joined-after)`; never reflected.

members.name: applyContext
members.description: Private property, it will use context value to setup selected state of component.

members.name: displayText
members.description: The text a `c2-select` shows for this row: `label` when set, otherwise the text content of the default slot.

members.name: activate
members.description: Behaves like a click: dispatches `click` on the row and, for a standalone row, toggles `selected`.

events.name: click
events.description: Fired when an enabled row is activated; a row with `href` also navigates.

events.name: selected-change
events.description: Fired after `selected` changes, whether from a click or from the parent list.

declarations.description:
A collapsible group of `c2-list-item` rows, for vertical application navigation. The header is a disclosure button
(`aria-expanded`) with the group's label, an optional icon and a count; the rows under it are hidden while the group
is closed. Groups nest: put a `c2-list-group` among the rows of another. Mark the row of the current route with
`current` on its `c2-list-item`.

Use it in a `<nav>`, not inside a `c2-list`: a list is a listbox that selects values, while a navigation list is a set
of links.

members.name: open
members.description: Whether the rows are shown. Toggled by the header; set it to open a group, such as the one holding the current route.

members.name: label
members.description: The heading, used when the `label` slot is empty.

members.name: toggle
members.description: Opens the group, or closes it when `force` is `false`. Without `force` it flips the state.

events.description: Fired after the group opens or closes (`newState` is `open` or `closed`). Does not bubble.
